column3: Postponing the team's division
Good grief. This is why mere humans are such annoying partners.
Hmmm...
Seems like this conversation worsened her mood.
I'm sorry to have wasted your energy.
Hmph... It is fine if you understand, "if".
If only that fashion monger over there could be as understanding as you are.
Huh? You said something?
Well, well! The three of you should calm down!
Let us leave team division out for now and concentrate on practicing versus battles, how about it?
Oh! That's a good idea!
Does anyone have any objections?
Objections... there is one.
When thinking about the risks with joining the tournament, I feel intimidated...
But if I just repeat myself, there's no way they'll accept it.
Then, I have no choice other than the amiable method.
So that's why I'm also involved in this game tournament's preparation.
And that's it! Thanks Kyousuke-shi for your consideration.
I do have an objection.
Hey!
Don't you have any consideration!?
Other than that, isn't there a more pressing issue at hand to be resolved?
What is it? Are you trying to begin a spiritual session?
Hmph... Something like that. A purification ceremony. In other words, an apology for your doings.
An apology? To you? ......Why?
Do you have trouble understanding the words I used?
I've been quietly listening so far, weren't you just spouting nonsense?
When have you been quiet? You're annoyingly bawling all the time.
Hah? What's that? I have no idea what you're saying.
...You two, you've been on repeat for a while...
Geez, this isn't getting anywhere.
What should I say to settle their endless quarrel?
Or rather, why are they participating in the tournament together if they're on such bad terms?
It's for the prize that's before them...
Kuroneko! Don't you want the ultra rare prize!?
...T-That...
You really want it, don't you? You do as well, Kirino.
Ugh... Of course.
Hehehe... Things are going as planned for once!
If you two can't get together, then the prize will end up in the hands of someone else!
Is that all right with you?
The ultra rare character costume, or the ultra rare sales promotion items, you don't want them?
Uuu... I want them so much...
Right? Then mind your attitude.
Phew... She will behave now.
Then, you will be my partner.
There isn't much time left until the tournament. We live in the same house, so we can train efficiently.
You have a point but...
What? Do you have any objections?
None, right? You can play games with suuuch a cute little sister!
...Where is that cute little sister?
Are your eyes rotten?
It looks like the partners have been decided.
Eh? Decided just like that?
...Though I think I would be the most suited to support you since your skills are the worst.
However if the siblings were to pair up, I can only team up with Saori then.
...Is it all right?
Didn't I say that it is? You're dragging on.
On the contrary, defeat is unacceptable with me.
Prepare yourself!
Got it...
In the days leading up to the competition, Kirino and I underwent backbreaking special training.
That being said, the one doing the backbreaking was me.
I was forced to constantly play Siscaly whenever we were home.
What happened during this time... Sorry, but let me omit it. I shone precisely because I exerted myself to remain silent!
--Then, on the day of the tournament.
As a result of this special training, our pair proceeded to secure an easy victory in the first round.
However, fate teased us again... We ended up against the Kuroneko-Saori team in the second round.
We tried our very best, but we still got defeated by the excellent teamwork of the Kuroneko-Saori team.
However, even with their powerful attack, the Kuroneko-Saori team lost by an hair in the finals.
Although Kirino was bitter, Kuroneko and Saori still got the second place prize that she wanted.
Well, I think those results were pretty good.
Ah... Should we leave it at that for today?
It's still too early to be deciding the teams at this point.
Take your time to consider your options, Kyousuke-shi.
R-Right...
Kiririn-shi, that's how it is.
Then let's call it a day.
See you!
...Phew.
Repent. Come on. Quickly.
Shut up, you evil Chuunibyou girl.
In the end, it's the same as before!
Two great men cannot coexist.
Not only can they not coexist, but they can only thwart and fight each other to the bitter end...
Ugh... This is without end...
In that case, me and you.
Eh?
You'll be my partner.
Kyousuke-shi and... me?
Hold on, what are you deciding all on your own?
That's right! If Saori becomes your partner, then wouldn't my partner automatically be this girl?
Isn't this a perfect opportunity to get to know each other?
If the prize is at stake, then you won't have the time to fight, right?
It's not like I want to fight. It's just that I got dragged in by her...
I, I'm also not interested in pointless arguments.
Then there's no problem. Saori and I on one team, Kuroneko and Kirino on the other.
In the days leading up to the competition, Saori and I used our free time to undergo a tough special training.
...Then, the day of the competition.
During the semifinals, Saori and I got defeated quickly by the perfectly coordinated Kirino-Kuroneko team.
However, even with their powerful attack, the Kirino-Kuroneko team lost by an hair in the final.
Kirino and Kuroneko were bitter. But I think that losing was a good thing.
Because although they lost, they got second place. That's awesome, they should be proud!
Besides...
United through a loss? It looks like their relationship improved.
...Though it could just be my imagination!
